title: PR body claims palcheck floors were re-pinned, but the commit contains no palcheck change — the commit message says the opposite
evidence:
PR body (the declared spec): "- **palcheck floors re-pinned where the puck shrink dropped pixel counts**
  (e.g. the puck hardware-tone floor) — measured on the re-blessed frames,
  keeping the crop/blit-canary job (a missing sprite still zeroes the count)." — but `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --stat -- harness/ tools/` is EMPTY (palcheck.odin last touched at eedf1ed, an ancestor of HEAD~1), and the puck hardware-tone floor is unchanged: harness/palcheck.odin:319 `check(count_near(calm, rl.Color{86, 98, 116, 255}, 12) > 200, "puck hardware tone", count_near(calm, rl.Color{86, 98, 116, 255}, 12))`. The commit message itself states the opposite: "palcheck stays green (floors had margin) - no re-pin needed."
detail: The PR body is the declared spec and the audit trail for the 113-golden re-bless; it asserts a floor re-pin that never happened. The commit message is accurate — palcheck verified green here with untouched floors.
recommended_fix: Amend the PR body's Golden re-bless section to match reality: palcheck stayed green on the existing floors (no re-pin), per the commit message.

title: camera_set_fit is orphaned — zero call sites remain after the change
evidence: app/main.odin:1746 `camera_set_fit :: proc(app: ^App) {` — repo-wide `grep -rn "camera_set_fit(" --include="*.odin" .` returns ONLY this definition (all three former call sites — start_run:972, effect_cancel:1135, camera_set_selection:1800 — now call camera_set_default). Its comment claims a live role: "// v2-camera-zoom-tiers: NO LONGER a resting home — it is the explicit OUT / LIMIT / not-the-resting-home framing" — but the actual manual out limit is effect_zoom's clamp at app/main.odin:1991: `z_to := clamp(rnd.camera_zoom_step(app.cam_zoom_to, delta), rnd.CAM_ZOOM_MIN, rnd.CAM_ZOOM_MAX)`.
detail: The diff orphans camera_set_fit entirely while its new comment ascribes it a role ("the explicit OUT LIMIT") that actually lives in effect_zoom's CAM_ZOOM_MIN clamp — misleading dead code.
recommended_fix: Delete camera_set_fit, or reword its comment to "retained for reference; unreferenced" — the out limit is effect_zoom's CAM_ZOOM_MIN clamp, not this proc.

title: PUCK_GROWTH_MAX cap never binds on shipped sprites and has no unit pin — deleting it fails no test
evidence: app/render/sprites.odin:274 `return 1.05 * v.tile_px * v.scale * min(sh.bboxes[idx][2] / base, PUCK_GROWTH_MAX)` — assets/sprites/sprites.json content_bbox: puck_1 [62, 106, 132, 121], puck_2 [53, 98, 150, 137], puck_3 [44, 90, 168, 153] → ratios 150/132=1.136 and 168/132=1.273, both below PUCK_GROWTH_MAX=1.30, so min() never clamps. `grep -rn "sprite_puck_target\|PUCK_GROWTH" app/render/*_test.odin app/*_test.odin` returns nothing — no unit pin exists, and goldens can't exercise the cap (ratios under it). PR body discloses: "shipped puck ratios top out at 1.27, inside the cap — the cap is the future-proof ceiling".
detail: The new cap branch is untestable-by-current-assets: removing min(…, PUCK_GROWTH_MAX) leaves all 49 demos and 385 tests green. Disclosed as future-proofing, but unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a render unit pin for sprite_puck_target with a stub bbox ratio above 1.30 (e.g. inject bboxes where idx width/base = 1.5 → target clamps at 1.05*1.30), so the cap can fail.

title: The at-DEFAULT_ZOOM pullback no-op (the documented accepted tradeoff) is described but never pinned
detail: The resting-state behavior this change introduces (boot camera at 2.0 ignores distant seeds) has no failing-capable pin; a future tweak to the z_to>=zoom return or floor changes it silently.
recommended_fix: Add one camera_pullback_target case: zoom=DEFAULT_ZOOM, district beyond the 2.0 viewport → expect active=false, zoom unchanged.

title: PR body's "48/48 green" T1 count is stale — the harness at this sha reports 49 demos
evidence: PR body: "- **T1 hashes: unchanged** (48/48 green — the sim never saw this change)." — but `tools/harness.sh run` at this sha prints "harness: 49 demo(s) green" and `ls demos/*.dem | wc -l` = 49; the 49th demo (dublin board, 2809eea, 2026-08-23) landed before this PR. The "48/48" figure is carried over from earlier PR bodies (_pr_body_ambience.md:24, _pr_body_camera_zoom.md:51, _pr_body_font_overhaul.md:43).
detail: Stale verification count copied from the previous wave; the substance (T1 unchanged, 0 .t1 files in the diff) is verified true, but the stated count matches no current total.
recommended_fix: Update the PR body count to the harness's actual "49 demo(s) green" (or drop the specific number).
